bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to agriculture; appropriating money for the Minnesota Black Farmers Association to purchase advanced 21st century farming equipment for use by a cooperative of Black veteran farmers.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+ADVANCED 21ST CENTURY FARMING EQUIPMENT FOR BLACK VETERAN FARMERS. +]

[+The commissioner of agriculture must award a grant to the Minnesota Black Farmers Association to purchase advanced 21st century farming equipment, including skid steers and John Deere tractors with attachments, for use by members of a cooperative of Black veteran farmers. +]

Sec. 2. [+APPROPRIATION. +]

[+$2,500,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of agriculture for a grant to the Minnesota Black Farmers Association to purchase advanced 21st century farming equipment for use by members of a cooperative of Black veteran farmers. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to agriculture; appropriating money for the Minnesota Black Farmers Association to purchase advanced 21st century farming equipment for use by a cooperative of Black veteran farmers.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. ADVANCED 21ST CENTURY FARMING EQUIPMENT FOR BLACK VETERAN FARMERS.

The commissioner of agriculture must award a grant to the Minnesota Black Farmers Association to purchase advanced 21st century farming equipment, including skid steers and John Deere tractors with attachments, for use by members of a cooperative of Black veteran farmers.

Sec. 2. APPROPRIATION.

$2,500,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of agriculture for a grant to the Minnesota Black Farmers Association to purchase advanced 21st century farming equipment for use by members of a cooperative of Black veteran farmers.
additions: ADVANCED 21ST CENTURY FARMING EQUIPMENT FOR BLACK VETERAN FARMERS.

The commissioner of agriculture must award a grant to the Minnesota Black Farmers Association to purchase advanced 21st century farming equipment, including skid steers and John Deere tractors with attachments, for use by members of a cooperative of Black veteran farmers.

$2,500,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of agriculture for a grant to the Minnesota Black Farmers Association to purchase advanced 21st century farming equipment for use by members of a cooperative of Black veteran farmers.
